MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TASSEL.title: Sword Tassel
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TASSEL.description:
Whenever a magic sword gains affinity, it gains {Bonus} more.
Upon pickup, every magic sword you own gains {Affinity} affinity.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TASSEL.flavor: A red knot tied to the pommel, warm from a hand that held it long.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-WORN_GRIP.title: Worn Grip
MAGICSWORDSMAN-WORN_GRIP.description: Whenever you summon a sword at [gold]Trusted[/gold] affinity or higher, draw {Cards} {Cards:plural:card|cards}. At [gold]Bonded[/gold], also gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-WORN_GRIP.flavor: However many blades it changes, the hand reaches for this grip first.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-HEARTBOUND_SCABBARD.title: Heartbound Scabbard
MAGICSWORDSMAN-HEARTBOUND_SCABBARD.descr: In combat, magic swords at [gold]Trusted[/gold] affinity or higher count as {Levels} level higher (max 5).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-HEARTBOUND_SCABBARD.flavo: A blade held by a trusting hand grows a hair sharper on its own.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TSUBA.title: Tsuba
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TSUBA.description: Whenever your [gold]current sword[/gold] changes, deal {Damage} damage to a random enemy.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TSUBA.flavor: When blade crosses blade, the guard rings first.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TWIN_SCABBARD.title: Twin Scabbard
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TWIN_SCABBARD.description: The first time you play a [purple]Union[/purple] card each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TWIN_SCABBARD.flavor: Two blades in one sheath, from two different graves, sleeping side by side.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-OLIFANT.title: Olifant
MAGICSWORDSMAN-OLIFANT.description: The first time each combat that damage leaves you at {HpThreshold}% HP or less, gain {Block} [gold]Block[/gold] and draw {Cards} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-OLIFANT.flavor: At Roncevaux, Roland sounded the horn too late, so hard his temples burst.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SILVER_HAND.title: Silver Hand
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SILVER_HAND.description: Whenever you draw a Curse, draw {Cards} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SILVER_HAND.flavor: Nuada lost his arm in battle. Dian Cécht made him a new one of silver.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-COOLED_FURNACE.title: Cooled Furnace
MAGICSWORDSMAN-COOLED_FURNACE.descriptio:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.
You can no longer use [gold]Forge Sword[/gold] at Rest Sites.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-COOLED_FURNACE.flavor: After three months the iron still would not melt. Only the heat remains for one who let the fire die.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TOMB_LANTERN.title: Tomb Lantern
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TOMB_LANTERN.description: At the start of each combat, summon the sword you own with the highest affinity that has not come out yet (your current sword does not change).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TOMB_LANTERN.flavor: Raise the lantern, and the nearest blade wakes first.
